title: Get a licence to run a market
what: Get the council's licence before setting up or running a market on council property or a public place.

laws.title: Shire of Denmark Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2026

sources.title: Shire of Denmark Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2026
sources.locator: cl 3.1(1)(g), as made, Gazette No. 4, 6 Jan 2026
sources.quote: A person shall not without a licence—

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found.

assessment.summary: Running a market on council land needs the council's licence.

marks.reason: A licence, set days and times, and conditions.
